verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is a compliance and AML screening SaaS, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows no such feature. It documents screening, ongoing monitoring, a user-configured risk-score equation, and case and alert review with manual decisions. None of this is described as AI-generated insight or suggestion. The llms.txt probe concerns how the docs are made available, not an in-product AI capability.
